question: Which of the following is used in cough syrups?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethanol.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ethanol **(C2H5OH) **is used in cough syrups and **tonics because it is a very good solvent.**__
 
• Ethanol (also **called ethyl alcohol,** grain alcohol, drinking alcohol,** spirits, or simply alcohol**) is an organic chemical compound. It is a simple alcohol with the** chemical formula C2H5OH.**
 
• Ethanol is a volatile, flammable, **colorless liquid **with a slight characteristic odor. It is a **psychoactive substance** recreational drug and an active ingredient in **alcoholic drinks.**
 
• Ethanol, often in high concentrations, is used to **dissolve many water-insoluble** medications and related compounds. Liquid preparations of** pain medications**, cough, and cold medicines, and **mouthwashes, for example**, may contain up to** 25% ethanol **and may need to be avoided in** individuals with adverse reactions **to ethanol such as alcohol-induced respiratory reactions.
 
• Ethyl alcohol is used in** cough syrups **and tonics for the **cure of respiratory and cough-related diseases.**
 
• Because of its high solubility, **ethanol is used in cough syrups and tonics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** **Butanol:-**

 
• 1-Butanol, also known as** butan-1-ol **or n-butanol, is a **primary alcohol **with the chemical **formula C₄H₉OH** and a linear structure.
 
• Isomers of 1-butanol are** isobutanol, butan-2-ol **and tert-butanol. The **unmodified **term butanol usually refers to the **straight-chain isomer.**
 
• It is used as a solvent for fats,** waxes, shellacs, resins, gums, and varnish,** in making hydraulic fluids, and in medications for animals. determine potentially hazardous exposures.

** Propanol:-**

 
• Propan-1-ol is a** primary alcohol with the formula CH₃CH₂CH₂OH** and is sometimes represented a**s PrOH or n-PrOH**. It is a **colorless liquid** and an isomer of 2-propanol.
 
• Most commonly propanol is **used as a solvent **or it is used to produce other solvents such as **antifreeze, lacquer formulations, soaps, dye solutions, window cleaners, and more.**
 
• Compounds of propanol like **isopropanol or isopropyl **alcohol are **most commonly used** in the printing industry and in printing ink.

** Texanol:-**

 
• It is an ideal choice as a** retarder solvent** for use in coil coatings and** high-bake enamels.**
 
• Its unique balance of** properties also makes it useful** for a variety of chemical specialty applications such as ore** flotation/frothing,** **oil-drilling muds, wood preservative carriers, and floor polishes.**
